title: Branch valve mass, connector system, and header strain redistribution covariance
reason: KEL branch-valve work prevents unjustified F2/F2D and enforces containment, but more covariance data is needed to rank PS/F1/F2 choices with branch valve mass and top-frame geometry.
required_before_claim: Before claiming one branch-valve connector system is globally low-strain optimal, compare header and branch responses across connector systems and valve mass/station sweeps.
